item.title: In photos: National Lucho Wrestling Championship in Juybar
item.description: The National Lucho Wrestling Championship, held in memory of the champions “Hossein Ali Nowrouzian and Mohammad Hassan Naghibi,” took place on November 14, 2026 in Juybar, Mazandaran Province.

item.title: Iran condemns international human rights bodies’ silence on Gaza
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s High Council for Human Rights has condemned the silence and inaction of international human rights bodies over the continued Israeli crimes in Gaza, calling for an end to impunity and for concrete action to uphold human rights.

item.title: Envoy: Accepting Tehran’s terms, only path to balanced talks with US
item.description: Islamabad, IRNA – Iran’s ambassador in Pakistan underscored the country’s unwavering steadfastness against American bullying and economic terrorism, and said, “If America implements them, accepts them, we are ready to sit down and negotiate with them.”

item.title: In photos: Iran marks National Book Week
item.description: The opening ceremony of the 34th National Book Week was held in Tehran on November 15, 2026, attended by President Masoud Pezeshkian and the Minister of Culture and Islamic Guidance, Seyyed Abbas Salehi.

item.title: In photos: Handicrafts exhibition opens in Iran’s Semnan
item.description: The second National Handicrafts Exhibition is being held in Semnan, central Iran, from November 15 to 21, 2026, bringing together artists and handicrafts producers from across the country to showcase their works, expand sales opportunities, and strengthen business ties.

item.title: US actions have undermined trust in diplomacy: Foreign Ministry spokesperson
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says Washington had undermined the credibility of diplomacy by using negotiations as cover for surprise attacks twice in less than nine months, urging countries to view US claims about diplomatic engagement with caution.

item.title: Yemen to release hundreds of enemy prisoners: Official
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Yemen will release hundreds of prisoners captured on the battlefronts in previous years under an amnesty declared by Ansarullah Leader Abdul-Malik al-Houthi, a Yemeni official says.

item.title: Ghalibaf to Bessent: Reflect on your strategic failures instead of insulting nations
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has criticized US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent for his offensive remarks about Iran, saying Washington should reflect on its strategic failures in the Persian Gulf rather than insult other nations.

item.title: Hamas official urges action as humanitarian crisis worsens in Gaza
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Khalil al-Hayya, head of Hamas’ Political Bureau, has urged Arab and Islamic countries to act to address the humanitarian crisis in the Gaza Strip, citing the blockade, shortages of food, and mounting hardship as winter approaches.

item.title: Pezeshkian orders emergency response to deadly bus crash in western Iran
item.description: Ilam, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian has issued special instructions and called for the mobilization of all available resources to ensure immediate medical and emergency assistance for those injured in a deadly bus accident in Ilam Province, western Iran.

item.title: Baqaei: US claims that Iran started war are ‘fabrication’ to evade responsibility for unlawful aggression
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has strongly reacted to US President Donald Trump’s claim that the ongoing war was started by Iran with its 1979 Islamic Revolution, saying that such a “deceptive narrative” is a fabrication intended to evade responsibility for the unlawful

item.title: Bus crash in western Iran kills 12, injures 16
item.description: Ilam, IRNA – Twelve people were killed, and sixteen others were injured when a bus carrying oil company employees overturned in Ilam Province, western Iran, the governor of Abdanan County says.

item.title: Six drones targeted US air defense radar at Bahrain helicopter base: IRGC
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) has announced that six drones struck a US air defense radar installation at the Riffa helicopter base in Bahrain during the second phase of Iran’s response to US military aggression.

item.title: IRGC: Two oil tankers violating restrictions hit mines, catch fire south of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) has announced that two oil tankers violating restrictions have hit naval mines south of the Strait of Hormuz and are on fire.

item.title: General Mohebbi: Ridiculous claim of IRGC attack on cooling systems in France is Israeli scenario
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The spokesperson for the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC), Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi, in a message, emphasized that the ridiculous claim of an attack on cooling systems in France is a scenario by the Zionists.

item.title: Baqaei: US admits it is committing war crimes, economic terrorism against Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says the United States has openly acknowledged its pursuit of war crimes by threatening to starve the Iranian people through a blockade.

item.title: Iran welcomes India’s diplomatic efforts to promote regional peace: Envoy
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Ambassador to India Mohammad Fathali says Iran welcomes India’s initiatives and diplomatic efforts to help establish peace in the region.

item.title: Yemen’s armed forces say they struck Saudi-backed forces in Lahj
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Yemen’s armed forces have targeted gatherings of Saudi-backed forces on several fronts in the southern province of Lahj, killing and wounding dozens of fighters.

item.title: Ayatollah Khamenei’s martyrdom strengthened national unity: VP Aref
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – First Vice President Mohammad-Reza Aref says the martyrdom of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, has strengthened national unity and resolve to continue his path.

item.title: 18 Muslim-majority countries condemn Israeli attack on Gaza’s Nasser hospital
item.description: Tehran, IRNA - Foreign ministers from 18 Arab and Islamic nations strongly condemned the Israeli deadly airstrike on Nasser Medical Complex in Gaza, which led to casualties among patients and medical staff.

item.title: Iran seeks fair treatment on nuclear rights, sovereignty over Strait of Hormuz: VP
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Vice President for Legal Affairs Majid Ansari has emphasized that Iran seeks fair treatment and respect for its nuclear rights, territorial sovereignty, and authority over the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: IRGC downs 17th US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guard Corps (IRGC) says it has shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in the Persian Gulf, marking the 17th such drone it has downed.

item.title: Russia’s St. Petersburg ready to expand industrial, trade ties with Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Officials from St. Petersburg have expressed readiness to expand industrial, scientific, and trade cooperation with Iran in various fields, Iran’s Mines and Mining Industries Development and Renovation Organization (IMIDRO) announces.

item.title: Another violating tanker catches fire east of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Iranian Navy reported on Saturday that another offending oil tanker caught fire earlier in the day, after striking a naval mine in a prohibited area east of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: In photos: Flamingos return to Iran’s Maharlu Lake
item.description: Flamingos have returned to Maharlu Lake in Fars Province, southern Iran, with the arrival of autumn and cooler temperatures, transforming the seasonal wetland into a spectacular wildlife habitat.

item.title: Tehran hosts funeral procession for 110 unidentified Iranian soldiers
item.description: A funeral procession for 110 unidentified Iranian martyrs who were killed in action during the 1980–1988 Iran-Iraq War was held in Tehran on November 13, 2026, coinciding with the anniversary of the martyrdom of Hazrat Fatemeh Zahra (PBUH). item.title: Iranian students win six gold medals at Open World Astronomy Olympiad
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iranian students have won six gold medals at the 2026 Open World Astronomy Olympiad (OWAO) held in Russia’s Sirius Federal Territory.

item.title: Women’s Football League: Persepolis vs. Sepahan
item.description: The women’s football match between Persepolis and Sepahan was held on November 9, 2026, at Shahid Kazemi Stadium in Tehran. The match, held on Day 7 of Iran’s Women’s Premier League, ended in a 1–0 victory for Persepolis.

item.title: Iran, Turkiye call for stronger environmental cooperation
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran and Turkiye have agreed to expand bilateral environmental cooperation, speed up the implementation of existing agreements, and share experience in building resilient cities and managing waste.

item.title: Russia and China urge immediate end to war against Iran, stress negotiated solution
item.description: New York, IRNA — The Russian and Chinese ambassadors to the United Nations have expressed concern over US and Israeli threats of renewed hostilities against Iran, stressing the need to pursue political and diplomatic means to establish peace.
